notes: Deck and writing rounds have the thick ShiHanzi2 bar that catches fire on a run of right answers (2 in a row amber, 3 a flame, 5 a blaze with sparks, 10 blue-hot), with this round's XP counting up beside it. Every card earns XP (1 Forgot, 2 Almost, 3 Knew it) and a finished round 10 more; the end page shows the XP earned. Profile has a week of XP as a chart. Words you miss twice or more are offered as a Tricky words deck at the end of a round. The blue test copy label is gone
